behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Upsert Harvest into Notion" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "api.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Every Few Minutes" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.
